irradiance_source.note: shortwave_radiation_sum is daily global horizontal irradiation (GHI) in MJ/m2; divided by 3.6 to give kWh/m2.

delivery.note: Power Automate uploads day D's workbook on D+1 morning. A day counts as missed once D+1 has passed due_by_local_hour in the site timezone, which leaves grace for a late upload before anything is flagged.
